posts.title: Burn All GIFs-day was 27 years ago
posts.description: Burn All GIFs-day was 27 years ago Today is the 27th anniversary of Burn All GIFs-day. Burn All GIFs-day On November 5 1999, Burn All GIFs day , people were asked to delete their GIF files. The LZW algorithm that made GIFs possible was actually under patent. The patent was owned by a company called Unisys Corp. The problem that caused the Burn All GIFs-day was a sudden requirement to pay a royalty
